basics.name: Markus Frohmann
basics.label: NLP Researcher & AI Graduate Student
basics.summary: M.S. student in Artificial Intelligence at Johannes Kepler University Linz, specializing in Natural Language Processing and multimodal AI. Experienced researcher with publications at top-tier conferences (ACL, EMNLP, ISMIR) and research experience at ETH Zürich and Deezer Research.

honors: Visiting Student at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (Spring 2025)
education.thesis: Robust AI-Generated Lyrics Detection (Advisor: Prof. Markus Schedl)
Simple and Efficient Task Transfer by Learning to Scale (Advisor: Dr. Navid Rekabsaz)

work.name: Deezer Research
work.summary: Designed methods to robustly detect synthetic (AI-generated) lyrics from audio and text under supervision of Dr. Elena Epure and Dr. Gabriel Meseguer-Brocal.
highlights: Developed multimodal approaches for AI-generated content detection
Published research at ACL 2025 and ISMIR 2025

work.name: ETH Zürich, Institute for Machine Learning (Rycolab)
work.summary: Introduced frameworks to build any-to-any multimodal models, focusing on video understanding under supervision of Prof. Ryan Cotterell and Dr. Mario Giulianelli.

work.name: Johannes Kepler University, Institute of Computational Perception
work.summary: Developed various modular, efficient, and multilingual methods in NLP under advisors Prof. Markus Schedl and Dr. Navid Rekabsaz.
highlights: Published multiple papers at top-tier conferences
Specialized in efficient NLP methods and task transfer

work.name: Bosch
work.summary: Developed production-grade predictive maintenance models and created a company-wide MLOps curriculum.
highlights: Created MLOps curriculum for company-wide adoption

work.name: Leftshift One
work.summary: Designed, built and deployed end-to-end machine learning solutions for various customers.
